links.outcome: Validity of automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore) versus blinded physician ratings
links.effect: BERTScore correlated with physician quality ratings in the intervention group but not in the non-displayed group. Unseen drafts had BERTScore F1 0.83 versus physician messages, yet physicians preferred human-authored messages (4.24/5).
links.quote: Automated metrics demonstrated context-dependent validity; they assessed editing fidelity but failed to evaluate whether AI-generated content matches independent human performance.

links.outcome: Silent (non-displayed) draft generation revealing AI versus independent physician performance
links.effect: In 45,127 non-displayed messages, the silent comparison showed automated similarity did not track physician-rated quality, which the displayed-draft condition alone would not reveal.
links.quote: BERTScore correlated with physician quality ratings in the intervention group but not in the non-displayed.

links.outcome: Validity of automated message-quality metrics against blinded physician ratings
links.effect: BERTScore F1 = 0.93 for incorporated drafts and 0.83 for independent physician messages. BERTScore correlated with physician quality ratings in the intervention group but not in the non-displayed group.
links.quote: Automated metrics demonstrated context-dependent validity; they assessed editing fidelity but failed to evaluate whether AI-generated content matches independent human performance.

links.outcome: Physician preference for human-authored versus AI-generated messages
links.effect: Physicians preferred human-authored messages (4.24/5) despite comparable semantic scores.
links.quote: Despite comparable semantic scores, physicians preferred human-authored messages (4.24/5).

links.effect: Automated metrics failed to evaluate whether AI-generated content matched independent human performance, despite assessing editing fidelity.
links.quote: Automated metrics demonstrated context-dependent validity; they assessed editing fidelity but failed to evaluate whether AI-generated content matches independent human performance.

links.effect: Physicians preferred independent human-authored messages over the AI drafts despite comparable semantic scores.
